cresceretefaciatdeusmeussicutarenammaris.en: My God make thee to grow as the sand of the sea, and give thee a blessing of the dew of heaven.
cresceretefaciatdeusmeussicutarenammaris.la: Créscere te fáciat Deus meus sicut arénam maris: et donet tibi de rore cæli benedictiónem.

quimaledixerittibisitillemaledictusetqui.en: Whoso curseth thee, let him be cursed: and whoso blesseth thee, let him be filled with blessings.
quimaledixerittibisitillemaledictusetqui.la: Qui maledíxerit tibi, sit ille maledíctus: et qui benedíxerit tibi, benedictiónibus repleátur.

dumexiretiacobdeterrasuaviditgloriamdeie.en: When Jacob went forth from his own land, he saw the glory of God, and said:
dumexiretiacobdeterrasuaviditgloriamdeie.la: Dum exíret Jacob de terra sua, vidit glóriam Dei, et ait:

quamterribilisestlocusistenonesthicaliud.en: How terrible is this place! this is no other but the house of God, and the gate of heaven.
quamterribilisestlocusistenonesthicaliud.la: Quam terríbilis est locus iste! non est hic áliud, nisi domus Dei, et porta cœli.

sidominusdeusmeusfueritmecuminviaistaper.en: If the Lord my God shall be with me in this way by which I walk, and shall keep me.
sidominusdeusmeusfueritmecuminviaistaper.la: Si Dóminus Deus meus fúerit mecum in via ista, per quam ego ámbulo, et custodíerit me.

faciamushictriatabernaculatibiunummoysiu.en: Let us make here * three tabernacles: one for thee, one for Moses, and one for Elias.
faciamushictriatabernaculatibiunummoysiu.la: Faciámus hic * tria tabernácula: tibi unum, Móysi unum, et Elíæ unum. Ps. 269, 270, 271

egodeusomnipotensambulacorammeetestoperf.en: I am God almighty: walk before me, and be perfect.
egodeusomnipotensambulacorammeetestoperf.la: Ego Deus omnípotens, ámbula coram me, et esto perféctus.

quimaiorestvestrumeritministervesterquia.en: He that is the greater among you * shall be your servant: for every one that exalteth himself shall be humbled, saith the Lord.
quimaiorestvestrumeritministervesterquia.la: Qui major est vestrum, * erit miníster vester: quia omnis qui se exáltat, humiliábitur, dicit Dóminus.

sedereautemmecumnonestmeumdarevobissedqu.en: But to sit with me * is not mine to give you, but to them for whom it is prepared by my Father.
sedereautemmecumnonestmeumdarevobissedqu.la: Sedére autem mecum * non est meum dare vobis: sed quibus parátum est a Patre meo.

veniteadoremusdominumdeumnostrumquifecit.en: Come, let us adore the Lord our God: * Who hath made us.
veniteadoremusdominumdeumnostrumquifecit.la: Veníte adorémus Dóminum Deum nostrum: * Qui fecit nos.

dixitiudasfratribussuisecceismelitetrans.en: Juda said to his brethren: Behold, the Ismaelites pass by; come, let him be sold,
dixitiudasfratribussuisecceismelitetrans.la: Dixit Judas frátribus suis: Ecce Ismaëlítæ tránseunt; veníte, venumdétur,

etmanusnostrenonpolluanturcarenimetfrate.en: And let not our hands be defiled: for he is our flesh and our brother.
etmanusnostrenonpolluanturcarenimetfrate.la: Et manus nostræ non polluántur: caro enim et frater noster est.

videsitunicfiliituisitannonetcumvidisset.en: See whether it be thy son's coat, or not: and when the father had seen it, he said:
videsitunicfiliituisitannonetcumvidisset.la: Vide, si túnic fílii tui sit, an non: et cum vidísset pater, ait:

igituriosephductusestinegyptumfuitquedom.en: So Joseph was brought into Egypt, and the Lord was with him:
igituriosephductusestinegyptumfuitquedom.la: Igitur Joseph ductus est in Ægýptum, fuítque Dóminus cum eo:

perquemeratvirincunctisprospereagens.en: Through whom he was a man prospering in all things.
perquemeratvirincunctisprospereagens.la: Per quem erat vir in cunctis próspere agens.

misertusenimestdeusilliusetomnieiusopera.en: For God had mercy on him, and directed all his works,
misertusenimestdeusilliusetomnieiusopera.la: Misértus enim est Deus illíus, et ómnia ejus ópera dirigébat,

salusnostrainmanutuestdominerespiciatsup.en: Our safety is in thy hand, O Lord: let thy mercy look upon us,
salusnostrainmanutuestdominerespiciatsup.la: Salus nostra in manu tua est, Dómine: réspiciat super nos misericórdia tua,

utsecuriserviamusregi.en: That we may serve the king in safety.

veneruntquoqueegyptiiadiosephdicentesdan.en: The Egyptians also came to Joseph, saying: Give us food, that we may live.
veneruntquoqueegyptiiadiosephdicentesdan.la: Venérunt quoque Ægýptii ad Joseph, dicéntes: Da nobis aliménta, ut vívere possímus.

nondicotibipetredimitendumseptiessedusqu.en: I say not to thee, Peter, * that thou forgive seven times, but unto seventy times seven times.
nondicotibipetredimitendumseptiessedusqu.la: Non dico tibi Petre, * dimiténdum sépties, sed usque septuágies sépties.

quibiberitaquamquamegododicitdominussama.en: He that shall drink of the water * that I give, saith the Lord to the woman of Samaria, it shall become in him a fountain of water, springing up into life everlasting.
quibiberitaquamquamegododicitdominussama.la: Qui bíberit aquam, * quam ego do, dicit Dóminus Samaritánæ, fiet in eo fons aquæ saliéntis in vitam ætérnam.

populusdominietovespascueeiusveniteadore.en: The people of the Lord, and the sheep of his pasture: * Come, let us adore him.
populusdominietovespascueeiusveniteadore.la: Pópulus Dómini, et oves páscuæ ejus, * Veníte, adorémus eum.

locutusestdominusadmoysendicensdescendei.en: The Lord spake unto Moses, saying: Go down into Egypt, and say to Pharao that he let my people go:
locutusestdominusadmoysendicensdescendei.la: Locútus est Dóminus ad Móysen, dicens: Descénde in Ægýptum, et dic Pharaóni ut dimíttat pópulum meum:

induratumestcorpharaonisnonvultdimittere.en: The heart of Pharao is hardened: he will not let my people go, but by a mighty hand.
induratumestcorpharaonisnonvultdimittere.la: Indurátum est cor Pharaónis: non vult dimíttere pópulum meum, nisi in manu forti.

vidensvidiafflictionempopulimeiinegyptet.en: Seeing I have seen the affliction of my people in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them.
vidensvidiafflictionempopulimeiinegyptet.la: Videns vidi afflictiónem pópuli mei in Ægypto, et gémitum eórum audívi, et descéndi liberáre eos.

curruspharaonisetexercitumeiusproiecitin.en: Pharao's chariots and his army he hath cast into the sea.
curruspharaonisetexercitumeiusproiecitin.la: Currus Pharaónis et exércitum ejus projécit in mare.

inmarivietueetsemitetueinaquismultisdedu.en: Thy way is in the sea, and thy paths in many waters: thou hast conducted thy people like sheep
inmarivietueetsemitetueinaquismultisdedu.la: In mari viæ tuæ, et sémitæ tuæ in aquis multis: deduxísti sicut oves pópulum tuum

inmanumoysietaaron.en: By the hand of Moses and Aaron.

clamaveruntfiliiisrelinangustiasuaadtedo.en: The children of Israel cried unto thee, O Lord, in their distress, and thou didst send them a Saviour.
clamaveruntfiliiisrelinangustiasuaadtedo.la: Clamavérunt fílii Israël in angústia sua ad te, Dómine, et misísti eis Salvatórem.

eccemittoangelummeumquiprecedatteetcusto.en: Behold, I send my Angel, who shall go before thee, and keep thee always: observe and hear my voice, and I will be an enemy to thy enemies, and will afflict them that afflict thee:
eccemittoangelummeumquiprecedatteetcusto.la: Ecce mitto Angelum meum, qui præcédat te, et custódiat semper: obsérva et audi vocem meam, et inimícus ero inimícis tuis, et affligéntes te afflígam:

etprecedetteangelusmeus.en: And my Angel shall go before thee.

descenditmoysesdemonteportansduastabulas.en: Moses came down from the mount, carrying in his hands two tables of stone, written both of them with the finger of God.
descenditmoysesdemonteportansduastabulas.la: Descendit Móyses de monte, portans duas tábulas lapídeas in mánibus suis scriptas utrásque dígito Dei.

dequinquepanibusetduobuspiscibussatiavit.en: With five loaves and two fishes * did the Lord satisfy five thousand men.
dequinquepanibusetduobuspiscibussatiavit.la: De quinque pánibus * et duóbus píscibus satiávit Dóminus quinque míllia hóminum. Ps. 269, 270, 271

vosquitransituriestisiordanemedificateal.en: Ye that are to pass over the Jordan, build an altar to the Lord of stones which iron hath not touched:
vosquitransituriestisiordanemedificateal.la: Vos, qui transitúri estis Jordánem, ædificáte altáre Dómino de lapídibus, quos ferrum non tétigit:

etoffertesuperilludholocaustethostiaspac.en: And offer upon it holocausts and peace offerings to your God.
etoffertesuperilludholocaustethostiaspac.la: Et offérte super illud holocáusta, et hóstias pacíficas Deo vestro.

populemeusquidfecitibiautquidmolestusfui.en: O my people, what have I done to thee, or wherein have I molested thee? answer thou me: for I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt:
populemeusquidfecitibiautquidmolestusfui.la: Pópule meus, quid feci tibi, aut quid moléstus fui? Respónde mihi: quóniam ego edúxi te de terra Ægypti:

unumopusfecietomnesadmiraminiquiatotumho.en: One work * I have done, and ye all wonder, because I have healed the whole man on the Sabbath.
unumopusfecietomnesadmiraminiquiatotumho.la: Unum * opus feci, et omnes admirámini, quia totum hóminem sanum feci in Sábbato.

rabbiquispeccavithicautparenteseiusquodc.en: Rabbi, who hath sinned, * this man or his parents, that he should be born blind? Jesus answered and said: Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents; but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
rabbiquispeccavithicautparenteseiusquodc.la: Rabbi, quis peccávit * hic, aut paréntes ejus, quod cæcus nascerétur? Respóndit Jesus, et dixit: Neque hic peccávit, neque paréntes ejus: sed ut manifesténtur ópera Dei in illo.

dixivobisiametaudistislutummihiposuitill.en: I have told you already, * and ye have heard: he that is called Jesus put clay upon me.
dixivobisiametaudistislutummihiposuitill.la: Dixi vobis jam, * et audístis, lutum mihi pósuit ille qui dícitur Jesus.

egosumluxmundiquisequiturmenonambulatint.en: I am * the light of the world: he that followeth me walketh not in darkness, but shall have the light of life, saith the Lord.
egosumluxmundiquisequiturmenonambulatint.la: Ego sum * lux mundi: qui séquitur me, non ámbulat in ténebris, sed habébit lumen vitæ, dicit Dóminus.

quicustodiebantanimammeamconsiliumfeceru.en: They that watched my soul consulted together, saying:
quicustodiebantanimammeamconsiliumfeceru.la: Qui custodiébant ánimam meam, consílium fecérunt in unum, dicéntes:

deusdereliquiteumpersequiminietcomprehen.en: God hath forsaken him: pursue and take him, for there is none to deliver him: O my God, be not thou far from me: O my God, make haste to my help.
deusdereliquiteumpersequiminietcomprehen.la: Deus derelíquit eum, persequímini et comprehéndite eum: quia non est qui líberet eum: Deus meus, ne elongéris a me: Deus meus, in adjutórium meum inténde.

netradiderismeinanimastribulantiummequon.en: Deliver me not over to the will of them that trouble me: for unjust witnesses have risen up against me:
netradiderismeinanimastribulantiummequon.la: Ne tradíderis me in ánimas tribulántium me: quóniam insurrexérunt in me testes iníqui:

quidamautemiudeidicebantquiabonusestalii.en: And some * of the Jews said: He is a good man. And others said: No, but he seduceth the people.
quidamautemiudeidicebantquiabonusestalii.la: Quidam autem * Judæi dicébant: Quia bonus est. Alii autem dicébant: Non, sed sedúcit turbas.

pateriustemundustenoncognovitegoautemnov.en: O just Father, * the world has not known thee: I however have known thee, for thou hast sent me.
pateriustemundustenoncognovitegoautemnov.la: Pater juste, * mundus te non cognóvit: ego autem novi te, quia tu me misísti.

circumdederuntmevirimendacessinecausafla.en: Lying men have compassed me about: without cause have they beaten me with scourges:
circumdederuntmevirimendacessinecausafla.la: Circumdedérunt me viri mendáces, sine causa flagéllis cecidérunt me:

sedtudominedefensorvindicame.en: But thou, O Lord, my defender, avenge me.
sedtudominedefensorvindicame.la: Sed tu, Dómine, defénsor víndica me.

quoniamtribulatioproximestetnonestquiadi.en: For trouble is near, and there is none to help.
quoniamtribulatioproximestetnonestquiadi.la: Quóniam tribulátio próxima est, et non est qui ádjuvet.

clarificamepaterapudtemetipsumclaritateq.en: Father, glorify Thou Me * with thine Own Self, with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
clarificamepaterapudtemetipsumclaritateq.la: Clarífica me, Pater, * apud temetípsum claritáte, quam hábui, priúsquam mundus fíeret.

ipsiverononcognoveruntviasmeasquibusiura.en: But they have not known my ways, * Unto whom I swore in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
ipsiverononcognoveruntviasmeasquibusiura.la: Ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas, * Quibus jurávi in ira mea, si introíbunt in réquiem meam.

indiequainvocavitedominedixistinolitimer.en: In the day that I called upon thee, O Lord, thou saidst: Fear not; thou hast judged my cause,
indiequainvocavitedominedixistinolitimer.la: In die qua invocávi te, Dómine, dixísti: Noli timére; judicásti causam meam,

etliberastimedominedeusmeus.en: And thou hast delivered me, O Lord my God.
etliberastimedominedeusmeus.la: Et liberásti me, Dómine, Deus meus.

homopacismeeinquosperabamampliavitadvers.en: The man of my peace, in whom I trusted, hath greatly supplanted me:
homopacismeeinquosperabamampliavitadvers.la: Homo pacis meæ in quo sperábam, ampliávit advérsum me supplantatiónem:

ingredientedominoinsantamcivitatemhebreo.en: As the Lord entered into the holy city, the children of the Hebrews, proclaiming the resurrection of life,
ingredientedominoinsantamcivitatemhebreo.la: Ingrediénte Dómino in santam civitátem, Hebræórum púeri resurrectiónem vitæ pronuntiántes:

cumramispalmarumhosannaclamabantinexcels.en: With branches of palms cried out: Hosanna in the highest.
cumramispalmarumhosannaclamabantinexcels.la: Cum ramis palmárum Hosánna clamábant in excélsis.

cumaudissetpopulusquiaiesusvenitierosoly.en: When the people had heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem, they went forth to meet him:
cumaudissetpopulusquiaiesusvenitierosoly.la: Cum audísset pópulus, quia Jesus venit Jerosólymam, exiérunt óbviam ei:

tuautemdominesabaothquiiudicasiusteetpro.en: But thou, O Lord of Sabaoth, who judgest justly, and triest the reins and the hearts,
tuautemdominesabaothquiiudicasiusteetpro.la: Tu autem Dómine Sábaoth, qui júdicas juste, et probas renes et corda,

contumeliasetterrorespassussumabeisquier.en: I have suffered reproaches and terrors from them that were my familiars, and watched my side, saying: Let us deceive him, and prevail against him: but thou, O Lord, art with me as a strong warrior: let them fall into everlasting reproach, that I may see thy revenge upon them,
contumeliasetterrorespassussumabeisquier.la: Contumélias et terróres passus sum ab eis, qui erant pacífici mei, et custodiéntes latus meum, dicéntes: Decipiámus eum, et prævaleámus illi: sed tu, Dómine, mecum es tamquam bellátor fortis: cadant in oppróbrium sempitérnum, ut vídeam vindíctam in eis,

quiatibirevelavicausammeam.en: For to thee have I revealed my cause.

improperiaimproperantiumtibicecideruntsu.en: The reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
improperiaimproperantiumtibicecideruntsu.la: Impropéria improperántium tibi cecidérunt super me.

animammeamdilectamtradidiinmanusiniquoru.en: I have given my dear soul into the hands of the wicked, and my inheritance is become to me as a lion in the wood: the adversary hath cried out against me, saying: Come together, and make haste to devour him:
animammeamdilectamtradidiinmanusiniquoru.la: Animam meam diléctam trádidi in manus iniquórum, et facta est mihi heréditas mea sicut leo in silva: dedit contra me voces adversárius, dicens: Congregámini, et properáte ad devorándum illum:

posueruntmeindesertumsolitudinisetluxits.en: They have made me a waste wilderness, and all the earth hath mourned over me: for there was none found that would know me, and do good.
posueruntmeindesertumsolitudinisetluxits.la: Posuérunt me in desértum solitúdinis, et luxit super me omnis terra: quia non est invéntus qui me agnósceret, et fáceret bene.

pastoresmultidemolitisuntvineammeamconcu.en: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot:
pastoresmultidemolitisuntvineammeamconcu.la: Pastóres multi demolíti sunt víneam meam, conculcavérunt partem meam:

etdederuntinescammeamfeletinsitimeapotav.en: And they gave me gall for my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
etdederuntinescammeamfeletinsitimeapotav.la: Et dedérunt in escam meam fel, et in siti mea potavérunt me acéto.

ceperuntomnesturbedescendentiumgaudentes.en: The whole multitude * of them that were coming down began with joy to praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works they had seen, saying: Blessed be the King who cometh in the name of the Lord, peace in heaven, and glory on high.
ceperuntomnesturbedescendentiumgaudentes.la: Cœpérunt * omnes turbæ descendéntium gaudéntes laudáre Deum voce magna super ómnibus quas víderant virtútibus, dicéntes: Benedíctus qui venit Rex in nómine Dómini, pax in cœlo et glória in excélsis.

dixeruntimpiiapudsenonrectecogitantescir.en: The wicked said among themselves, reasoning not aright: Let us lie in wait for the just, because he is contrary to our doings: he boasteth that he hath the knowledge of God, and calleth himself the Son of God, and glorieth that he hath God for his father: let us see if his words be true: and if he be the true Son of God, let him deliver him from our hands:
dixeruntimpiiapudsenonrectecogitantescir.la: Dixérunt ímpii apud se, non recte cogitántes: Circumveniámus justum, quóniam contrárius est opéribus nostris: promíttit se sciéntiam Dei habére, Fílium Dei se nóminat, et gloriátur patrem se habére Deum: videámus si sermónes illíus veri sunt: et si est vere Fílius Dei, líberet eum de mánibus nostris:

morteturpissimacondemnemuseum.en: Let us condemn him to a most shameful death.

viriimpiidixeruntopprimamusvirumiustumin.en: Wicked men said: Let us oppress the just man unjustly, and for his spoils let us cast lots:
viriimpiidixeruntopprimamusvirumiustumin.la: Viri ímpii dixérunt: Opprimámus virum justum injúste, et de spóliis ejus sortem mittámus:

viriimpiidixeruntopprimamusvirumiustumin.en: Wicked men said: Let us oppress the just man unjustly, and swallow him up alive as hell: let us take away the memory of him from the earth: and for his spoils let us cast lots among us: for these murderers have treasured up evil to themselves: the foolish and the wicked have hated wisdom:
viriimpiidixeruntopprimamusvirumiustumin.la: Viri ímpii dixérunt: Opprimámus virum justum injúste, et deglutiámus eum tamquam inférnus vivum: auferámus memóriam illíus de terra: et de spóliis ejus sortem mittámus inter nos: ipsi enim homicídæ thesaurizavérunt sibi malum: insipiéntes et malígni odérunt sapiéntiam:

etreifactisuntincogitationibussuis.en: And they are become guilty in their thoughts.
etreifactisuntincogitationibussuis.la: Et rei facti sunt in cogitatiónibus suis.

dixeruntimpiiapudsenonrectecogitantescir.en: The wicked said among themselves, reasoning not aright: Let us lie in wait for the just, because he is contrary to our doings:
dixeruntimpiiapudsenonrectecogitantescir.la: Dixérunt ímpii apud se, non recte cogitántes: Circumveniámus justum, quóniam contrárius est opéribus nostris:

recordaremeidomineettueremeabhisquiperse.en: Remember me, * O Lord, and defend me from them that persecute me.
recordaremeidomineettueremeabhisquiperse.la: Recordáre * mei, Dómine, et tuére me ab his, qui persequúntur me.

dormiteiametrequiesciteecceappropinquabi.en: Sleep ye now, and take your rest: behold, he is at hand that will betray me:
dormiteiametrequiesciteecceappropinquabi.la: Dormíte jam, et requiéscite; ecce appropinquábit, qui me traditúrus est:

videdomineetconsideraquoniamtribulorvelo.en: Behold, O Lord, and see, * for I am in trouble; hear me speedily.
videdomineetconsideraquoniamtribulorvelo.la: Vide, Dómine, * et consídera, quóniam tríbulor: velóciter exáudi me.

discernecausammeamdomineabhomineiniquetd.en: Plead my cause, * O Lord; deliver me from the unjust and deceitful man.
discernecausammeamdomineabhomineiniquetd.la: Discérne causam meam, * Dómine: ab hómine iníquo et dolóso éripe me.

dumtribularerclamaviaddominumdeventreinf.en: When I was in trouble, * I cried to the Lord out of the belly of hell, and he heard me.
dumtribularerclamaviaddominumdeventreinf.la: Dum tribulárer, * clamávi ad Dóminum de ventre ínferi, et exaudívit me.

dixeruntimpiiopprimamusvirumiustumquonia.en: The ungodly said Let us oppress the righteous man, * because he is clean contrary to our doings.
dixeruntimpiiopprimamusvirumiustumquonia.la: Dixérunt ímpii: * Opprimámus virum justum, quóniam contrárius est opéribus nostris.

potestatemhabeoponendianimammeametiterum.en: I have power * to lay down my life: and to take it up again.
potestatemhabeoponendianimammeametiterum.la: Potestátem hábeo * ponéndi ánimam meam, et íterum suméndi eam.

nemotollitameanimammeamsedegoponeametite.en: No man * taketh my life away from me, but I lay it down, and I take it up again.
nemotollitameanimammeamsedegoponeametite.la: Nemo * tollit a me ánimam meam, sed ego pono eam, et íterum sumo eam.

animeimpiorumfremebantadversummeetgravat.en: The souls of the wicked * raged against me, and my heart was heavy because of them.
animeimpiorumfremebantadversummeetgravat.la: Animæ impiórum * fremébant advérsum me, et gravátum est cor meum super eos.

synagogepopulorumcircumdederuntmeetnonre.en: The assemblies of the peoples have compassed me about: and I have not rendered evil to them that repaid me: the wickedness of sinners shall be brought to nought, O Lord,
synagogepopulorumcircumdederuntmeetnonre.la: Synagógæ populórum circumdedérunt me: et non réddidi retribuéntibus mihi mala: consumétur, Dómine, nequítia peccatórum,

etdirigesiustum.en: And thou shalt direct the just.

tuautemdominesusceptormeusesgloriameetex.en: But thou, O Lord, art my protector, my glory, and the lifter up of my head.
tuautemdominesusceptormeusesgloriameetex.la: Tu autem, Dómine, suscéptor meus es, glória mea, et exáltans caput meum.

audivienimcontumeliasmultorumetterroremi.en: For I have heard the reproaches of many, and terror on every side, saying:
audivienimcontumeliasmultorumetterroremi.la: Audívi enim contumélias multórum, et terrórem in circúitu dicéntium:

liberamedesanguinibusdeusdeusmeusetexsul.en: Deliver me * from blood, O God, my God: and my tongue shall extol thy justice.
liberamedesanguinibusdeusdeusmeusetexsul.la: Líbera me * de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus meus: et exsultábit lingua mea justítiam tuam.

contumeliasetterrorespassussumabeisetdom.en: I received * injuries and terrors from them: but the Lord is with me as a strong warrior.
contumeliasetterrorespassussumabeisetdom.la: Contumélias * et terróres passus sum ab eis: et Dóminus mecum est tamquam bellátor fortis.

omnesinimicimeiaudieruntmalummeumdominel.en: All my enemies * have heard of my evil, O Lord: they have rejoiced, for thou hast done it.
omnesinimicimeiaudieruntmalummeumdominel.la: Omnes inimíci mei * audiérunt malum meum: Dómine, lætáti sunt, quóniam tu fecisti.

consiliumfeceruntinimicimeidicentesconte.en: My enemies * took counsel together, saying: Let us cut him off from the land of the living.
consiliumfeceruntinimicimeidicentesconte.la: Consílium * fecérunt inimíci mei, dicéntes: Conterámus eum de terra vivéntium.

ancilladixitpetroveretuexillisesnametloq.en: The handmaid said * to Peter: Surely thou art one of them: for even thy speech doth discover thee.
ancilladixitpetroveretuexillisesnametloq.la: Ancílla dixit * Petro: Vere tu ex illis es: nam et loquéla tua maniféstum te facit.

tantotemporevobiscumeramdocensvosintempl.en: So long a time * was I with you, teaching you in the temple, and ye laid not hold on me: and behold, ye lead me scourged to be crucified.
tantotemporevobiscumeramdocensvosintempl.la: Tanto témpore * vobíscum eram docens vos in templo, et non me tenuístis, et ecce flagellátum dúcitis ad crucifigéndum.

quotidieapudvoseramintemplodocensetnonme.en: Daily * was I with you in the temple teaching, and ye laid not hold on me: and behold, ye lead me scourged to be crucified.
quotidieapudvoseramintemplodocensetnonme.la: Quotídie * apud vos eram in templo docens, et non me tenuístis, et ecce flagellátum dúcitis ad crucifigéndum.

alleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluia.en: Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
alleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluia.la: Allelúia, * allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.

alleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluia.en: Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
alleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluia.la: Allelúia, * allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia. Ps. 1, 2, 8, 15, 23, 27

infractionepanisalleluia.en: In the breaking of bread, alleluia.

angelusdominidescenditdeceletaccedensrev.en: The Angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone, and sat upon it, and said unto the women: Fear not ye; for I know that ye seek Him That was crucified.
angelusdominidescenditdeceletaccedensrev.la: Angelus Dómini descéndit de cœlo, et accédens revólvit lápidem, et super eum sedit, et dixit muliéribus: Nolíte timére: scio enim quia crucifíxum quǽritis:

iamsurrexitveniteetvidetelocumubipositus.en: He is risen already. Come, see the place where the Lord was laid, alleluia.
iamsurrexitveniteetvidetelocumubipositus.la: Jam surréxit: veníte, et vidéte locum, ubi pósitus erat Dóminus, allelúja.

angelusdominilocutusestmulieribusdicensq.en: The Angel of the Lord spake unto the women, saying: Whom seek ye? seek ye Jesus?
angelusdominilocutusestmulieribusdicensq.la: Angelus Dómini locútus est muliéribus, dicens: Quem quǽritis? an Jesum quǽritis?

ecceprecedetvosingalileamibieumvidebitis.en: Behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him, as he told you:
ecceprecedetvosingalileamibieumvidebitis.la: Ecce præcédet vos in Galilǽam, ibi eum vidébitis, sicut dixit vobis:

mariamagdaleneetalteramariaibantdiluculo.en: Mary Magdalen and the other Mary went at break of day to the sepulchre, and the Angel saith to them: He whom ye seek is not here, he is risen, as he said:
mariamagdaleneetalteramariaibantdiluculo.la: María Magdaléne, et áltera María ibant dilúculo ad monuméntum, et dicit illis Angelus: Quem quǽritis non est hic, surréxit sicut locútus est:

precedetvosingalileamibieumvidebitis.en: He goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see Him.
precedetvosingalileamibieumvidebitis.la: Præcédet vos in Galilǽam, ibi eum vidébitis.

citeuntesdicitediscipuliseiusetpetroquia.en: Go quickly, and tell his disciples and Peter that the Lord is risen:
citeuntesdicitediscipuliseiusetpetroquia.la: Cito eúntes dícite discípulis ejus, et Petro, quia surréxit Dóminus:

surgensiesusdominusnosterstansinmediodis.en: Jesus our Lord, rising again, standing in the midst of his disciples, said: Peace be to you, alleluia:
surgensiesusdominusnosterstansinmediodis.la: Surgens Jesus Dóminus noster, stans in médio discipulórum suórum, dixit: Pax vobis, allelúja:

gavisisuntdiscipulivisodominoalleluia.en: The disciples were glad when they saw the Lord, alleluia.
gavisisuntdiscipulivisodominoalleluia.la: Gavísi sunt discípuli viso Dómino, allelúja.

surrexitdominusdesepulchroquipronobispep.en: The Lord is risen from the sepulchre, who for us hung upon the tree.
surrexitdominusdesepulchroquipronobispep.la: Surréxit Dóminus de sepúlchro, qui pro nobis pepéndit in ligno.

christusresurgensexmortuisiamnonmoriturm.en: Christ rising again from the dead dieth now no more, death shall no more have dominion over him:
christusresurgensexmortuisiamnonmoriturm.la: Christus resúrgens ex mórtuis, jam non móritur, mors illi ultra non dominábitur:

tuleruntdominummeumetnescioubiposuerunte.en: They have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him: the Angel saith to her:
tuleruntdominummeumetnescioubiposuerunte.la: Tulérunt Dóminum meum, et néscio, ubi posuérunt eum: ait ei Angelus:

nolifleremariasurrexitsicutdixitprecedet.en: Weep not, Mary, he is risen as he said; he goeth before you into Galilee, there shall ye see him.
nolifleremariasurrexitsicutdixitprecedet.la: Noli flére, Maria, surréxit sicut dixit, præcédet vos in Galilǽam, ibi eum vidébitis.

dumergofleretinclinavitseetprospexitinmo.en: Now as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre: and she saw two Angels in white sitting, who say to her.
dumergofleretinclinavitseetprospexitinmo.la: Dum ergo fleret, inclinávit se, et prospéxit in monuméntum: et vidit duos Angelos in albis, sedéntes, qui dicunt ei.

siconsurrexistiscumchristoquesursumsuntq.en: If ye be risen with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is sitting at the right hand of God:
siconsurrexistiscumchristoquesursumsuntq.la: Si consurrexístis cum Christo, quæ sursum sunt quǽrite, ubi Christus est in déxtera Dei sedens:

quesursumsuntsapitenonquesuperterramalle.en: Mind the things that are above, not the things that are upon the earth, alleluia.
quesursumsuntsapitenonquesuperterramalle.la: Quæ sursum sunt sápite, non quæ super terram, allelúia.

mortuienimestisetvitavestrestabsconditac.en: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ.
mortuienimestisetvitavestrestabsconditac.la: Mórtui enim estis, et vita vestra est abscóndita cum Christo.

etunusdesenioribusdixitmihinefleverisdig.en: And one of the ancients said to me: Weep not: the Lamb that was slain is worthy to receive power and strength.
etunusdesenioribusdixitmihinefleverisdig.la: Et unus de senióribus dixit mihi: Ne fléveris: dignus est Agnus, qui occísus est, accípere virtútem, et fortitúdinem.

surrexitdominusdesepulcroalleluia.en: The Lord is risen from the sepulcher, alleluia.

quipronobispependitinlignoalleluia.en: Who for us hung upon the tree, alleluia.
quipronobispependitinlignoalleluia.la: Qui pro nobis pepéndit in ligno, allelúja.

letenturcelietexsultetterraantefaciemdom.en: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad before the face of the Lord.
letenturcelietexsultetterraantefaciemdom.la: Læténtur cæli et exsultet terra ante fáciem Dómini.

etvaldemaneunasabbatorumveniuntadmonumen.en: And very early in the morning, the first day of the week, they come to the sepulchre,
etvaldemaneunasabbatorumveniuntadmonumen.la: Et valde mane una Sabbatórum véniunt ad monuméntum,

mariamagdaleneetmariaiacobietsalomevener.en: Mary Magdalen, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome came at break of day to the sepulchre,
mariamagdaleneetmariaiacobietsalomevener.la: María Magdaléne, et María Jacóbi, et Salóme venérunt dilúculo ad monuméntum,

fratresexpurgatevetusfermentumutsitisnov.en: Brothers: Purge out the old leaven, that you may be a new paste, as you are unleavened. For Christ our pasch is sacrificed.
fratresexpurgatevetusfermentumutsitisnov.la: Fratres: Expurgáte vetus ferméntum, ut sitis nova conspérsio, sicut estis ázymi. Etenim Pascha nostrum immolátus est Christus.

hecdiesquamfecitdominus.en: This is the day which the Lord hath made.

exsultemusetletemurinea.en: Let us rejoice and be glad in it.

itaqueepulemurnoninfermentoveterinequein.en: Therefore let us feast, not with the old leaven, nor with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
itaqueepulemurnoninfermentoveterinequein.la: Itaque epulémur: non in ferménto véteri, neque in ferménto malítiæ et nequítiæ: sed in ázymis sinceritátis et veritátis.

christusresurgensexmortuisiamnonmoriturm.en: Christ * rising again from the dead dieth now no more, death shall no more have dominion over him: for in that he liveth, he liveth unto God, alleluia, alleluia.
christusresurgensexmortuisiamnonmoriturm.la: Christus * resúrgens ex mórtuis, jam non móritur, mors illi ultra non dominábitur, quod enim vivit, vivit Deo, allelúia, allelúia.

charitaschristiurgetnosestimanteshocquon.en: The charity of Christ presseth us: judging this, that if one died for all, * then all were dead: and Christ died for all: † that they also who live may not now live to themselves, * but unto him who died for them, and rose again.
charitaschristiurgetnosestimanteshocquon.la: Cháritas Christi urget nos: æstimántes hoc, quóniam si unus pro ómnibus mórtuus est, * ergo omnes mórtui sunt: et pro ómnibus mórtuus est Christus: † ut, et qui vivunt, jam non sibi vivant, * sed ei, qui pro ipsis mórtuus est, et resurréxit.

sanctachristiresurrectiositnobissalusetp.en: May the holy Resurrection of Christ † be our salvation and protection. †
sanctachristiresurrectiositnobissalusetp.la: Sancta Christi Resurréctio, † sit nobis salus et protéctio. †

quisunthisermonesquosconfertisadinvicema.en: What are these discourses * that ye hold one with another as ye walk, and are sad? alleluia, alleluia. And the one of them, whose name was Cleophas, answering, said to him: Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things that have been done there in these days? alleluia. To whom he said: What things? And they said: Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, who was a prophet, mighty in work and word before God and all the people, alleluia, alleluia.
quisunthisermonesquosconfertisadinvicema.la: Qui sunt hi sermónes * quos confértis ad ínvicem ambulántes, et estis tristes? allelúia, allelúia. Respóndens unus, cui nomen Cléophas, dixit ei: Tu solus peregrínus es in Jerúsalem, et non cognovísti quæ facta sunt in illa his diébus? allelúia. Quibus ille dixit: Quæ? Et dixérunt: De Jesu Nazaréno, qui fuit vir Prophéta, potens in ópere et sermóne coram Deo, et omni pópulo, allelúia, allelúia.

nonnecornostrumardenseratinnobisdeiesudu.en: Was not our heart * burning within us concerning Jesus, whilst he spoke to us in the way? alleluia.
nonnecornostrumardenseratinnobisdeiesudu.la: Nonne cor nostrum * ardens erat in nobis de Jesu, dum loquerétur nobis in via? allelúia.

obtuleruntdiscipulidominopartempiscisass.en: The disciples gave the Lord a piece * of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb, alleluia, alleluia.
obtuleruntdiscipulidominopartempiscisass.la: Obtulérunt * discípuli Dómino partem piscis assi, et favum mellis, allelúia, allelúia.

hociamtertiomanifestavitseiesuspostquamr.en: This is now the third time * that Jesus shewed himself, after he was risen from the dead, alleluia.
hociamtertiomanifestavitseiesuspostquamr.la: Hoc jam tértio * manifestávit se Jesus, postquam resurréxit a mórtuis, allelúja.

serminpsdediespasche.en: Sermon 52, on Psalm 117, on the day of holy Easter.
serminpsdediespasche.la: Serm. 52. in Ps. 117. de die S. Paschæ.

postdiesoctoianuisclausisingressusdominu.en: After eight days * came the Lord, the doors being shut, and said unto them: Peace be unto you, alleluia, alleluia.
postdiesoctoianuisclausisingressusdominu.la: Post dies octo * jánuis clausis ingréssus Dóminus dixit eis: Pax vobis, allelúia, allelúia.

multaquidemetaliasignafecitiesusinconspe.en: Many other signs also * did Jesus in the sight of his disciples, alleluia, which are not written in this book, alleluia.
multaquidemetaliasignafecitiesusinconspe.la: Multa quidem * et ália signa fecit Jesus in conspéctu discipulórum suórum, allelúia, quæ non sunt scripta in libro hoc, allelúia.

iesumquemqueritiscrucifixumnonesthicseds.en: Jesus, whom ye seek, who was crucified, * is not here, but is risen: remember how he spoke unto you, when he was yet in Galilee, alleluia.
iesumquemqueritiscrucifixumnonesthicseds.la: Jesum quem quæritis crucifíxum, * non est hic, sed surréxit: recordámini quáliter locútus sit vobis, dum adhuc in Galilæa esset, allelúia.

ingalileaiesumvidebitissicutdixivobisall.en: In Galilee * ye shall see Jesus, as I have told you, alleluia.
ingalileaiesumvidebitissicutdixivobisall.la: In Galilæa * Jesum vidébitis, sicut dixi vobis, allelúia.

surrexitenimsicutdixitdominusetprecedetv.en: For he is risen, * as the Lord said, and he goeth before you into Galilee, alleluia: there ye shall see him, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
surrexitenimsicutdixitdominusetprecedetv.la: Surréxit enim, * sicut dixit Dóminus, et præcédet vos in Galilæam, allelúia: ibi eum vidébitis, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.

surrexitdominusdesepulchroquipronobispep.en: The Lord is risen * from the sepulchre, who for us hung upon the tree, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
surrexitdominusdesepulchroquipronobispep.la: Surréxit * Dóminus de sepúlchro, qui pro nobis pepéndit in ligno, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.

angelusautemdominidescenditdeceletaccede.en: For an angel of the Lord * descended from heaven and coming rolled back the stone and sat upon it, alleluia, alleluia.
angelusautemdominidescenditdeceletaccede.la: Angelus autem Dómini, * descéndit de cœlo, et accédens revólvit lápidem, et sedébat super eum, allelúia, allelúia.

eratautemaspectuseiussicutfulgurvestimen.en: And his countenance * was as lightning, and his raiment as snow, alleluia, alleluia.
eratautemaspectuseiussicutfulgurvestimen.la: Erat autem * aspéctus ejus sicut fulgur, vestiménta ejus sicut nix, allelúia, allelúia.

pretimoreautemeiusexterritisuntcustodese.en: And for fear of him * the guards were struck with terror and became as dead men, alleluia.
pretimoreautemeiusexterritisuntcustodese.la: Præ timóre autem ejus * exterríti sunt custódes, et facti sunt velut mórtui, allelúia.

etrespicientesvideruntrevolutumlapidemer.en: And looking * they saw the stone rolled back, for it was very great, alleluia.
etrespicientesvideruntrevolutumlapidemer.la: Et respiciéntes * vidérunt revolútum lápidem: erat quippe magnus valde, allelúia.

hecautemscriptasuntutcredatisquiaiesuses.en: But these are written, * that ye may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing ye may have life in his name, alleluia.
hecautemscriptasuntutcredatisquiaiesuses.la: Hæc autem scripta sunt, * ut credátis quia Jesus est Christus Fílius Dei, et ut credéntes vitam habeátis in nómine ipsíus, allelúia.

fecitmedominusquasipatremregisetdominumu.en: The Lord hath made me as it were a father to the king, and lord of his whole house: be not afraid:
fecitmedominusquasipatremregisetdominumu.la: Fecit me Dóminus quasi patrem regis, et Dóminum univérsæ domus ejus: nolíte pavére:

prosaluteenimvestramisitmedeusantevosine.en: For God sent me before you into Egypt for your preservation. Alleluia.
prosaluteenimvestramisitmedeusantevosine.la: Pro salúte enim vestra misit me Deus ante vos in Ægyptum. Allelúia.

veniteadmeetegodabovobisomniabonaegyptie.en: Come unto me, and I will give you all the good things of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
veniteadmeetegodabovobisomniabonaegyptie.la: Veníte ad me, et ego dabo vobis ómnia bona Ægypti, et comedétis medúllam terræ.

alleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluia.en: Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
alleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluiaalleluia.la: Allelúia, * allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia. Ps. 256, 257, 258

aliasoveshabeoquenonsuntexhocovilietilla.en: And other sheep I have, * that are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice, and there shall be one fold and one shepherd, alleluia.
aliasoveshabeoquenonsuntexhocovilietilla.la: Alias oves hábeo, * quæ non sunt ex hoc ovíli: et illas opórtet me addúcere, et vocem meam áudient, et fiet unum ovíle, et unus pastor, allelúia.

etexivitvoxmagnadetemploathronodicens.en: And a great voice came out of the temple from the throne, saying:
etexivitvoxmagnadetemploathronodicens.la: Et exívit vox magna de templo a throno, dicens:

audivivocemdecelotamquamvocemtonitruimag.en: I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of great thunder, alleluia:
audivivocemdecelotamquamvocemtonitruimag.la: Audívi vocem de cælo, tamquam vocem tonítrui magni, allelúja:

regnabitdeusnosterineternumalleluiaquiaf.en: Our God shall reign for ever, alleluia, for now is come salvation, and strength, and the power of his Christ, alleluia, alleluia.
regnabitdeusnosterineternumalleluiaquiaf.la: Regnábit Deus noster in ætérnum, allelúja, quia facta est salus, et virtus, et potéstas Christi ejus, allelúja, allelúja.

vidiportamcivitatisadorientempositametap.en: I saw the gate of the city set toward the East, and the names of the Apostles and of the Lamb written thereon:
vidiportamcivitatisadorientempositametap.la: Vidi portam civitátis ad Oriéntem pósitam, et Apostolórum nómina et Agni super eam scripta:

etsupermuroseiusangelorumcustodiam.en: And upon the walls thereof a guard of Angels.
etsupermuroseiusangelorumcustodiam.la: Et super muros ejus Angelórum custódiam.

vidisanctamcivitatemierusalemnovamparata.en: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
vidisanctamcivitatemierusalemnovamparata.la: Vidi sanctam civitátem Jerúsalem novam, parátam sicut sponsam ornátam viro suo.

speciosafactesetsuavisindeliciistuis.en: Thou art become beautiful and sweet in thy delights:
speciosafactesetsuavisindeliciistuis.la: Speciósa facta es et suávis in delíciis tuis:

hecestierusalemcivitasmagnacelestisornat.en: This is Jerusalem, the great heavenly city, adorned as the bride of the Lamb:
hecestierusalemcivitasmagnacelestisornat.la: Hæc est Jerúsalem cívitas magna cæléstis, ornáta tamquam sponsa Agni:

quoniamtabernaculumfactestalleluia.en: For she is become a tabernacle. * Alleluia.

porteeiusnonclauderuntperdiemnoxenimnone.en: The gates thereof shall not be shut by day, for there shall be no night there:
porteeiusnonclauderuntperdiemnoxenimnone.la: Portæ ejus non claudérunt per diem, nox enim non erit in ea:

quoniamtabernaculumfactest.en: For she is become a tabernacle.

iterumautemvidebovosetgaudebitcorvestrum.en: But I will see you again, * and your heart shall rejoice, alleluia, and your joy no man shall take from you, alleluia.
iterumautemvidebovosetgaudebitcorvestrum.la: Iterum autem * vidébo vos, et gaudébit cor vestrum, allelúja, et gáudium vestrum nemo tollet a vobis, allelúja.

quitimetisdominumlaudateeumuniversumseme.en: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him: all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him.
quitimetisdominumlaudateeumuniversumseme.la: Qui timétis Dóminum, laudáte eum: univérsum semen Jacob, glorificáte eum.

cantatedominocanticumnovumcantatedominoo.en: Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: sing to the Lord, all the earth.
cantatedominocanticumnovumcantatedominoo.la: Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.

videhumilitatemmeameteripemequialegemtua.en: See my humiliation, and deliver me, for I have not forgotten thy law:
videhumilitatemmeameteripemequialegemtua.la: Vide humilitátem meam, et éripe me, quia legem tuam non sum oblítus:

psalmumdiciteeialleluia.en: Sing ye a psalm to him, alleluia.

dicantnuncquiredemptisuntalleluiaadomino.en: Let them say so now that have been redeemed, alleluia, by the Lord,
dicantnuncquiredemptisuntalleluiaadomino.la: Dicant nunc, qui redémpti sunt, allelúia, a Dómino,

vadoadeumquimisitmesedquiaheclocutussumv.en: I go to him * that sent me: but because I have spoken these things to you, sorrow hath filled your heart, alleluia.
vadoadeumquimisitmesedquiaheclocutussumv.la: Vado ad eum * qui misit me: sed quia hæc locútus sum vobis, tristítia implévit cor vestrum, allelúia.

adhucmultahabeovobisdiceresednonpotestis.en: I have yet many things * to say to you, but ye cannot bear them now: but when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will teach you all truth, alleluia.
adhucmultahabeovobisdiceresednonpotestis.la: Adhuc multa hábeo * vobis dícere, sed non potéstis portáre modo: cum autem vénerit ille Spíritus veritátis, docébit vos omnem veritátem, allelúja.

illemeclarificabitquiademeoaccipietetann.en: He shall glorify me, * because he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it to you, alleluia.
illemeclarificabitquiademeoaccipietetann.la: Ille me clarificábit, * quia de meo accípiet, et annuntiábit vobis, allelúja.

usquemodononpetistisquidquaminnominemeop.en: Hitherto * have ye asked nothing in My Name, ask, and ye shall receive. Alleluia.
usquemodononpetistisquidquaminnominemeop.la: Usque modo * non petístis quidquam in nómine meo: pétite, et accipiétis, allelúja.

vadopararevobislocumetiterumveniamadvosa.en: I go * to prepare a place for you, and I will come again to you, alleluia, and your heart shall rejoice, alleluia, alleluia.
vadopararevobislocumetiterumveniamadvosa.la: Vado * paráre vobis locum, et íterum véniam ad vos, allelúia, et gaudébit cor vestrum, allelúia, allelúia.

nonvosrelinquamorphanosalleluiavadetveni.en: I will not leave you orphans, * alleluia; I go away, and come again unto you, alleluia, and your heart shall rejoice, alleluia.
nonvosrelinquamorphanosalleluiavadetveni.la: Non vos relínquam * órphanos, allelúia: vado et vénio ad vos, allelúia, et gaudébit cor vestrum, allelúia.

pacemmeamdovobisalleluiapacemrelinquovob.en: My peace I give unto you, * alleluia: peace I leave with you, alleluia.
pacemmeamdovobisalleluiapacemrelinquovob.la: Pacem meam do vobis, * allelúia: pacem relínquo vobis, allelúia.

virigalileiquidaspicitisincelumhiciesusq.en: Ye men of Galilee, * why stand ye gazing up into heaven? This same Jesus, Which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner, alleluia.
virigalileiquidaspicitisincelumhiciesusq.la: Viri Galilǽi, * quid aspícitis in cœlum? hic Jesus qui assúmptus est a vobis in cœlum, sic véniet, allelúia.

sicvenietquemadmodumvidistiseumeunteminc.en: He shall so come * as ye have seen him going into heaven, alleluia.
sicvenietquemadmodumvidistiseumeunteminc.la: Sic véniet * quemadmodum vidístis eum eúntem in cœlum, allelúia.

omnispulchritudodominiexaltatestsupersid.en: All the beauty of the Lord is exalted above the stars: his comeliness is in the clouds of heaven:
omnispulchritudodominiexaltatestsupersid.la: Omnis pulchritúdo Dómini exaltáta est super sídera: spécies ejus in núbibus cœli:

etnomeneiusineternumpermanetalleluia.en: And His Name endureth for ever. Alleluia.
etnomeneiusineternumpermanetalleluia.la: Et nomen ejus in ætérnum pérmanet, allelúia.

asummocelegressieiusetoccursuseiususquea.en: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and His circuit unto the ends of it.
asummocelegressieiusetoccursuseiususquea.la: A summo cœlo egréssio ejus, et occúrsus ejus usque ad summum ejus:

nonturbeturcorvestrumalleluiegovadoadpat.en: Let not your heart be troubled, * alleluia: I go to the Father, alleluia.
nonturbeturcorvestrumalleluiegovadoadpat.la: Non turbétur cor vestrum, * allelúia; ego vado ad Patrem, allelúia. Ps. 8, 10, 18, 20, 23, 29

dominusquidemiesuspostquamlocutusesteisa.en: And the Lord Jesus, * after he had spoken to them, ascended into heaven, and sitteth on the right hand of God, alleluia.
dominusquidemiesuspostquamlocutusesteisa.la: Dóminus quidem Jesus * postquam locútus est eis, ascéndit in cœlum, et sedet a dextris Dei, allelúia. Ps. 45, 46, 95, 96, 98, 102

exaltaredomineinvirtutetuaalleluia.en: Be thou exalted, O Lord, in thy own strength, alleluia.
exaltaredomineinvirtutetuaalleluia.la: Exaltáre, Dómine, in virtúte tua, allelúia.

cantabimusetpsallemusvirtutestuasallelui.en: We will sing and praise thy power, alleluia.
cantabimusetpsallemusvirtutestuasallelui.la: Cantábimus et psallémus virtútes tuas, allelúia.

asummocelegressieiusalleluia.en: His going out is from the end of heaven, alleluia.
asummocelegressieiusalleluia.la: A summo cœlo egréssio ejus, allelúia.

etoccursuseiususqueadsummumeiusalleluia.en: And his circuit even to the end thereof, alleluia.
etoccursuseiususqueadsummumeiusalleluia.la: Et occúrsus ejus usque ad summum ejus, allelúia.

nonvosrelinquamorphanosalleluia.en: I will not leave you orphans, alleluia.

veniamadvosetgaudebitcorvestrumalleluia.en: I will come to you, and your heart shall rejoice, alleluia.
veniamadvosetgaudebitcorvestrumalleluia.la: Véniam ad vos, et gaudébit cor vestrum, allelúia.

quisestisterexgloriedominusfortisetpoten.en: Who is this King of glory? the Lord who is strong and mighty: * the Lord mighty in battle. Lift up your gates, O ye princes, † and be ye lifted up, O eternal gates: * and the King of glory shall enter in. Who is this King of glory? the Lord of hosts, * he is the King of glory.
quisestisterexgloriedominusfortisetpoten.la: Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? Dóminus fortis et potens: * Dóminus potens in prǽlio. Attóllite portas, príncipes, vestras, † et elevámini, portæ æternáles: * et introíbit Rex glóriæ. Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? Dóminus virtútum * ipse est Rex glóriæ.

exaltaredominealleluia.en: Be Thou exalted, O Lord. Alleluia.

iteinorbemuniversumetpredicatedicentesal.en: Go ye into the whole world, and preach, saying, alleluia:
iteinorbemuniversumetpredicatedicentesal.la: Ite in orbem univérsum, et prædicáte, dicéntes, allelúia:

quicredideritetbaptizatusfueritsalvuseri.en: He that believeth, and is baptized, shall be saved. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.
quicredideritetbaptizatusfueritsalvuseri.la: Qui credíderit, et baptizátus fúerit, salvus erit, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.

euntesergodoceteomnesgentesbaptizanteseo.en: Going therefore, teach ye all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost.
euntesergodoceteomnesgentesbaptizanteseo.la: Eúntes ergo docéte omnes Gentes, baptizántes eos in nómine Patris, et Fílii, et Spíritus sancti.

quicedideritetbaptizatusfueritsalvuserit.en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
quicedideritetbaptizatusfueritsalvuserit.la: Qui cedíderit, et baptizátus fúerit, salvus erit, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.

cumqueintuerenturincelumeuntemillumecced.en: And while they were beholding him going up to heaven, behold, two men stood by them in white garments, who also said:
cumqueintuerenturincelumeuntemillumecced.la: Cumque intueréntur in cælum eúntem illum, ecce duo viri astitérunt juxta illos in véstibus albis, qui et dixérunt:

hiciesusquiassumptusestavobisincelumsicv.en: This Jesus who is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come as ye have seen him going into heaven.
hiciesusquiassumptusestavobisincelumsicv.la: Hic Jesus qui assúmptus est a vobis in cælum, sic véniet quemádmodum vidístis eum eúntem in cælum.

ponitnubemascensumsuumdominus.en: The Lord maketh the cloud his ascent:

quiambulatsuperpennasventorumalleluia.en: Who walketh upon the wings of the winds, alleluia.
quiambulatsuperpennasventorumalleluia.la: Qui ámbulat super pennas ventórum, allelúja.

quifacitangelossuosspiritusetministrossu.en: Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a burning fire:
quifacitangelossuosspiritusetministrossu.la: Qui facit Angelos suos spíritus, et minístros suos ignem uréntem:

quiambulassuperpennasventorumalleluia.en: Thou walkest upon the wings of the wind. Alleluia.
quiambulassuperpennasventorumalleluia.la: Qui ámbulas super pennas ventórum, allelúja.

patercumessemcumeisegoservabameosquosded.en: Father, while I was with them, I kept them whom thou gavest me, but now I come to thee:
patercumessemcumeisegoservabameosquosded.la: Pater, cum essem cum eis, ego servábam eos, quos dedísti mihi, nunc autem ad te vénio:

nonrogouttollaseosdemundosedutserveseosa.en: I pray not that thou shouldst take them out of the world, but that thou shouldst keep them from evil, * Alleluia.
nonrogouttollaseosdemundosedutserveseosa.la: Non rogo ut tollas eos de mundo, sed ut serves eos a malo, * Allelúia.

patersancteserveosinnominetuoquosdedisti.en: Holy Father, keep them in thy name whom thou hast given me:
patersancteserveosinnominetuoquosdedisti.la: Pater sancte, serva eos in nómine tuo, quos dedísti mihi:

nonrogouttollaseosdemundosedutserveseosa.en: I pray not that thou shouldst take them out of the world, but that thou shouldst keep them from evil,
nonrogouttollaseosdemundosedutserveseosa.la: Non rogo ut tollas eos de mundo, sed ut serves eos a malo,

quodpartusnostrevirginis.en: That the Offspring of our Virgin,

postsputaflagrapostcrucem.en: After spitting, scourges, after the cross,

paternesediiungitur.en: Is joined to the Father's throne.

nostresalutisvindici.en: To the champion of our salvation,

nostrumquodcorpusvexerit.en: For that he hath borne our body

sublimemadceliregiam.en: Up to the lofty palace of heaven.

sitnobiscumcelestibus.en: May there be to us with them of heaven

illisquodsepresentavit.en: To them, that he hath presented himself;

nobisquodsenonabstulit.en: To us, that he hath not taken himself away.

nuncprovocatisactibus.en: Now, our deeds being stirred up,

christumexpectarenosdecet.en: It behoveth us to await Christ,

vitaquetalivivere.en: And to live such a life

quepossitcelosscandere.en: As may be able to ascend the heavens.

quiscandissupersidera.en: Thou that hast gone up above the stars.

sanctachristiascensiositnobissalusetprot.en: May the holy Ascension of Christ † be our salvation and protection. †
sanctachristiascensiositnobissalusetprot.la: Sancta Christi Ascénsio, † sit nobis salus et protéctio. †

emittespiritumtuumetcreabunturalleluia.en: Send forth thy spirit, and they shall be created, alleluia.
emittespiritumtuumetcreabunturalleluia.la: Emítte spíritum tuum, et creabúntur, allelúia.

etrenovabisfaciemterrealleluia.en: And thou shalt renew the face of the earth, alleluia.

sidiligitismemandatameaservatealleluiaal.en: If ye love me, * keep my commandments, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
sidiligitismemandatameaservatealleluiaal.la: Si dilígitis me, * mandáta mea serváte, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.

rogabopatremmeumetaliumparaclitumdabitvo.en: I will ask * my Father, and he shall give you another Paraclete, alleluia.
rogabopatremmeumetaliumparaclitumdabitvo.la: Rogábo * Patrem meum, et álium Paráclitum dabit vobis, allelúia. Ps. 8, 15, 18, 22, 28, 32

factusestrepentedecelosonustamquamadveni.en: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a mighty wind coming: and it filled the whole house where they were sitting.
factusestrepentedecelosonustamquamadveni.la: Factus est repénte de cælo sonus, tamquam adveniéntis spíritus veheméntis, et replévit totam domum ubi erant sedéntes.

loquebanturvariislinguisapostolialleluia.en: The Apostles spoke in divers tongues, * Alleluia, alleluia.
loquebanturvariislinguisapostolialleluia.la: Loquebántur váriis linguis Apóstoli, * Allelúja, allelúja.

cumcomplerenturdiespentecosteserantomnes.en: When the days of Pentecost were accomplished, they were all together in one place, alleluia: and suddenly there came a sound from heaven, alleluia: as of a mighty wind, and it filled the whole house,
cumcomplerenturdiespentecosteserantomnes.la: Cum compleréntur dies Pentecóstes, erant omnes páriter in eódem loco, allelúja: et súbito factus est sonus de cælo, allelúja: tamquam spíritus veheméntis, et replévit totam domum,

quorumremiseritispeccataremittuntureis.en: Whose sins ye shall forgive, they are forgiven them.

nonvosrelinquamorphanosalleluiavadetveni.en: I will not leave you orphans, alleluia: I go, and I come to you:
nonvosrelinquamorphanosalleluiavadetveni.la: Non vos relínquam órphanos, allelúia: vado et vénio ad vos:

etgaudebitcorvestrumalleluiaalleluia.en: And your heart shall rejoice, alleluia, alleluia.
etgaudebitcorvestrumalleluiaalleluia.la: Et gaudébit cor vestrum, allelúia, allelúia.

factusestrepentedecelosonustamquamadveni.en: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a mighty wind coming:
factusestrepentedecelosonustamquamadveni.la: Factus est repénte de cælo sonus, tamquam adveniéntis spíritus veheméntis:

etrepletisuntomnesspiritusanctoalleluiaa.en: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
etrepletisuntomnesspiritusanctoalleluiaa.la: Et repléti sunt omnes Spíritu Sancto, allelúja, allelúja, allelúja.

factaautemhacvoceconvenitmultitudetmente.en: And when this voice was made, the multitude came together, and were confounded in mind:
factaautemhacvoceconvenitmultitudetmente.la: Facta autem hac voce, convénit multitúdo, et mente confúsa est:

quoniamaudiebatunusquisquelinguasuaillos.en: Because that every man heard them speak in his own tongue the wonderful works of God, alleluia.
quoniamaudiebatunusquisquelinguasuaillos.la: Quóniam audiébat unusquísque lingua sua illos loquéntes, magnália Dei, allelúja.

stupebantautemomnesetmirabantur.en: And they were all amazed, and wondered.

spiritusdominireplevittotamdomumubierant.en: The Spirit of the Lord filled the whole house where the Apostles were sitting:
spiritusdominireplevittotamdomumubierant.la: Spíritus Dómini replévit totam domum ubi erant sedéntes Apóstoli:

spiritussanctigratiailluminetsensusetcor.en: May the grace of the Holy Ghost † enlighten our senses and our hearts. †
spiritussanctigratiailluminetsensusetcor.la: Spíritus sancti grátia † illúminet sensus et corda nostra. †

nonenimmisitdeusfiliumsuuminmundumutiudi.en: For God sent not * his Son into the world, to judge the world, but that the world may be saved by him, alleluia.
nonenimmisitdeusfiliumsuuminmundumutiudi.la: Non enim misit Deus * Fílium suum in mundum, ut júdicet mundum, sed ut salvétur mundus per ipsum, allelúia.

amendicovobisquinonintratperostiuminovil.en: Amen, I say to you, * he that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up another way, the same is a thief and a robber: but he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep, alleluia.
amendicovobisquinonintratperostiuminovil.la: Amen, dico vobis, * qui non intrat per óstium in ovíle óvium, sed ascéndit aliúnde, ille fur est, et latro: qui autem intrat per óstium, pastor est óvium, allelúia.

egosumpanisvivusquidecelodescendisiquism.en: I am the living bread, * which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, for the life of the world, alleluia, alleluia.
egosumpanisvivusquidecelodescendisiquism.la: Ego sum panis vivus, * qui de cælo descéndi: si quis manducáverit ex hoc pane, vivet in ætérnum: et panis, quem ego dabo, caro mea est pro mundi vita, allelúia, allelúia.

amenamendicovobisquicreditinmehabetvitam.en: Amen, * amen I say unto you: he that believeth in me hath everlasting life, alleluia, alleluia.
amenamendicovobisquicreditinmehabetvitam.la: Amen, * amen dico vobis, qui credit in me, habet vitam ætérnam, allelúia, allelúia.

egressiduodecimapostolicircuibantpercast.en: The twelve Apostles going forth * went about through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing everywhere, alleluia, alleluia.
egressiduodecimapostolicircuibantpercast.la: Egréssi * duódecim Apóstoli circuíbant per castélla evangelizántes, et curantes ubíque, allelúia, allelúia.

factumestinunadierumetiesussedebatdocens.en: It came to pass * on a certain day, as Jesus sat teaching, that there were also Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, that were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was to heal them, alleluia, alleluia.
factumestinunadierumetiesussedebatdocens.la: Factum est * in una diérum, et Jesus sedébat docens, et erant Pharisæi sedéntes, et legis doctóres qui vénerant ex omni castéllo Galilææ, et Judææ, et Jerúsalem, et virtus erat Dómini ad sanándum eos, allelúia, allelúia.

iamnonmultaloquarvobiscumvenitenimprince.en: I will not now speak * many things with you, for the prince of this world cometh, and in me he hath not any thing: but that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father hath given me commandment, so do I, alleluia.
iamnonmultaloquarvobiscumvenitenimprince.la: Jam non multa * loquar vobíscum, venit enim princeps mundi hujus, et in me non habet quidquam: sed ut cognóscat mundus quia díligo Patrem, et sicut mandátum dedit mihi Pater, sic fácio, allelúia.

hiquilinguisloquunturnovisgalileisuntets.en: These that speak * with new tongues are Galileans, and they shall take up serpents, alleluia.
hiquilinguisloquunturnovisgalileisuntets.la: Hi qui linguis * loquúntur novis, Galilæi sunt, et serpentes tollent, allelúia.

honorvirtusetpotestasetimperiumsittrinit.en: Honour, power, and might, and dominion be to the Trinity in Unity, to the Unity in Trinity.
honorvirtusetpotestasetimperiumsittrinit.la: Honor, virtus, et potéstas, et impérium sit Trinitáti in Unitáte, Unitáti in Trinitáte.

trinitatiluxperennisunitatisitdecusperpe.en: To the Trinity be everlasting light, to the Unity be honour for evermore.
trinitatiluxperennisunitatisitdecusperpe.la: Trinitáti lux perénnis, Unitáti sit decus pérpetim.

benedictietclaritasetsapientietgratiarum.en: Benediction, * and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, honour, and power, and strength to our God for ever and ever. Amen.
benedictietclaritasetsapientietgratiarum.la: Benedíctio, * et cláritas, et sapiéntia, et gratiárum áctio, honor, virtus, et fortitúdo Deo nostro, in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen. Ps. 63

tibilaustibigloriatibigratiarumactioinse.en: To thee be praise, * to thee be glory, to thee be thanksgiving for evermore, O blessed Trinity.
tibilaustibigloriatibigratiarumactioinse.la: Tibi laus, * tibi glória, tibi gratiárum áctio in sǽcula sempitérna, o beáta Trínitas. Ps. 97

benedictusdominusdeusisrel.en: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel.

benedicatnosdeusdeusnoster.en: May God, our God, bless us.

magnusdominusetmagnavirtuseius.en: Great is the Lord, and great is his power:
magnusdominusetmagnavirtuseius.la: Magnus Dóminus, et magna virtus ejus:

etsapientieeiusnonestnumerus.en: And of his wisdom there is no number.
etsapientieeiusnonestnumerus.la: Et sapiéntiæ ejus non est númerus.

magnusdominusetlaudabilisnimisetmagnitud.en: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised, and of his greatness there is no end.
magnusdominusetlaudabilisnimisetmagnitud.la: Magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis, et magnitúdinis ejus non est finis.

summetrinitatisimplicideounadivinitasequ.en: To the most high Trinity, the one simple God, one Godhead, equal glory, coeternal majesty, to the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Ghost:
summetrinitatisimplicideounadivinitasequ.la: Summæ Trinitáti, simplici Deo, una divínitas, æquális glória, coætérna maiéstas, Patri, Prolique, sanctóque Flámini:

quitotumsubditsuisorbemlegibus.en: Who subjecteth the whole world to his laws.
quitotumsubditsuisorbemlegibus.la: Qui totum subdit suis orbem légibus.

prestetnobisgratiamdeitasbeatapatrisacna.en: May the blessed Godhead of the Father, and of the Son, and likewise of the gracious Spirit, grant us grace.
prestetnobisgratiamdeitasbeatapatrisacna.la: Præstet nobis grátiam Déitas beáta Patris, ac Nati, paritérque Spíritus almi.

benedicamusdeumcelietcoramomnibusviventi.en: Let us bless the God of heaven, and before all the living
benedicamusdeumcelietcoramomnibusviventi.la: Benedicámus Deum cæli, et coram ómnibus vivéntibus:

deumtimeetmandateiusobserva.en: Fear God, and keep his commandments;
deumtimeetmandateiusobserva.la: Deum time, et mandáta ejus obsérva;

timentibusdeumnihildeestnechisquieumdili.en: Nothing is wanting to them that fear God, nor to them that love him in truth:
timentibusdeumnihildeestnechisquieumdili.la: Timéntibus Deum nihil deest, nec his, qui eum díligunt in veritáte:

tibilaustibigloriatibigratiarumactio.en: To thee be praise, to thee be glory, to thee be thanksgiving,
tibilaustibigloriatibigratiarumactio.la: Tibi laus, tibi glória, tibi gratiárum áctio,

inseculasempiternaobeatatrinitas.la: In sǽcula sempitérna, o beáta Trínitas.

etbenedictumnomenglorietuesanctumetlauda.en: And blessed is the holy name of thy glory: and worthy to be praised, and exalted above all:
etbenedictumnomenglorietuesanctumetlauda.la: Et benedíctum nomen glóriæ tuæ sanctum: et laudábile et superexaltátum:

obeatetbenedictetgloriosatrinitaspateret.en: O blessed, * and blest, and glorious Trinity, Father, and Son, and Holy Ghost: to thee be praise, to thee be glory, to thee be thanksgiving.
obeatetbenedictetgloriosatrinitaspateret.la: O beáta, * et benedícta, et gloriósa Trínitas, Pater, et Fílius, et Spíritus sanctus: tibi laus, tibi glória, tibi gratiárum áctio.

obeatabenedictetgloriosaunitaspateretfil.en: O blessed, * blest, and glorious Unity, Father, and Son, and Holy Ghost, have mercy, have mercy, have mercy on us.
obeatabenedictetgloriosaunitaspateretfil.la: O beáta, * benedícta, et gloriósa Unitas, Pater, et Fílius , et Spíritus sanctus, miserére, miserére, miserére nobis.

overasummasempiternatrinitaspateretfiliu.en: O true, * supreme, everlasting Trinity, Father, and Son, and Holy Ghost, to thee be praise, to thee be glory, to thee be thanksgiving.
overasummasempiternatrinitaspateretfiliu.la: O vera, * summa, sempitérna Trínitas, Pater, et Fílius , et Spíritus sanctus, tibi laus, tibi glória, tibi gratiárum áctio.

overasummasempiternaunitaspateretfiliuse.en: O true, * supreme, everlasting Unity, Father, and Son, and Holy Ghost, have mercy, have mercy, have mercy on us.
overasummasempiternaunitaspateretfiliuse.la: O vera, * summa, sempitérna Unitas, Pater, et Fílius , et Spíritus sanctus, miserére, miserére, miserére nobis.

teiurelaudantteadorantteglorificantomnes.en: Rightly do they praise thee, * adore thee, glorify thee, all thy creatures, O blessed Trinity.
teiurelaudantteadorantteglorificantomnes.la: Te jure laudant, * te adórant, te gloríficant omnes creatúræ tuæ, o beáta Trínitas.

benedicatnosdeusdeusnosterbenedicatnosde.en: May God, our God, bless us, * May God bless us.
benedicatnosdeusdeusnosterbenedicatnosde.la: Benedícat nos Deus, Deus noster, * Benedícat nos Deus.

etmetuanteumomnesfinesterre.en: And let all the ends of the earth fear Him.
etmetuanteumomnesfinesterre.la: Et métuant eum omnes fines terræ.

manenobiscumdominequoniamadvesperascitut.en: Abide with us, O Lord, * for it is towards evening: that through thee, our food for the journey, we may be brought unto the day of eternal brightness.
manenobiscumdominequoniamadvesperascitut.la: Mane nobíscum, Dómine, * quóniam advesperáscit, ut per te, nostrum viáticum, perducámur ad diem claritátis ætérnæ. Ps. 109

recedantlegisveteradumnovasuperveniuntna.en: Let the old things of the law * give way, while the new come in their stead: for instead of the manna given to the fathers in the desert, Christ hath given us his own Body under the appearance of bread.
recedantlegisveteradumnovasuperveniuntna.la: Recédant * legis vétera, dum nova supervéniunt: nam pro manna dato pátribus in desérto, Christus nobis sub spécie panis próprium Corpus dedit. Ps. 110

figuramagnitypiciterminatverusagnusdumpr.en: The figure * of the typical lamb is fulfilled by the true Lamb, while for the solace of our way he is given us under the appearance of unleavened bread.
figuramagnitypiciterminatverusagnusdumpr.la: Figúram * agni typici términat verus Agnus, dum pro nostræ viæ solátio, sub panis ázymi spécie nobis datur. Ps. 115

sibinosincorporatpanisvitesimentepurafid.en: The bread of life * maketh us one body with itself, if with pure mind, firm faith, and perfect charity we be transformed into its likeness.
sibinosincorporatpanisvitesimentepurafid.la: Sibi nos * incórporat panis vitæ, si mente pura, fide firma, et charitáte perfécta, in ejus similitúdinem transformémur. Ps. 127

responsoriumdiscubuitiesusetdiscipulieiu.en: Responsory. Jesus sat down, and his disciples with him, and he said: With desire I have desired to eat this pasch with you, before I suffer: and having taken bread, giving thanks, he broke it, and gave it to them, * Saying: This is my Body.
responsoriumdiscubuitiesusetdiscipulieiu.la: Responsorium. Discúbuit Jesus, et discípuli ejus cum eo, et ait: Desidério desiderávi hoc Pascha manducáre vobíscum, ántequam pátiar: et accépto pane, grátias agens fregit, et dedit eis, * Dicens: Hoc est Corpus meum.

fecitassuerusgrandeconviviumcunctisprinc.en: Assuerus made a great feast for all his princes and his servants, that he might shew the riches of the glory of his kingdom.
fecitassuerusgrandeconviviumcunctisprinc.la: Fecit Assuérus grande convívium cunctis princípibus, et púeris suis, ut osténderet divítias glóriæ regni sui.

cibaviteosdominusexadipefrumenti.en: The Lord fed them * with the fat of wheat.
cibaviteosdominusexadipefrumenti.la: Cibávit eos Dóminus * ex ádipe fruménti.

etdepetramellesaturaviteos.en: And with honey out of the rock did He satisfy them.
etdepetramellesaturaviteos.la: Et de petra, melle saturávit eos.

homoquidamfecitcenammagnam.en: A certain man made a great supper.

magnificatdeipatrisvirginisquematrisunig.en: Magnifieth * the Only-begotten of God the Father and of the Virgin Mother the choir of all the faithful, to whom in this present pilgrimage, for the consolation of their hearts, he hath given, under the appearance of bread and wine, the precious Sacrament of his Body and Blood.
magnificatdeipatrisvirginisquematrisunig.la: Magníficat * Dei Patris, Virginísque Matris Unigénitum chorus cunctórum fidélium, quibus in peregrinatióne præsénti, ad suórum córdium consolatiónem, sub spécie panis et vini, dedit pretiósum Córporis et Sánguinis Sacraméntum.

veniteadmeomnesquilaboratisetegoreficiam.en: Come unto me, all ye that labour, * And I will refresh you.
veniteadmeomnesquilaboratisetegoreficiam.la: Veníte ad me, omnes qui laborátis, * Et ego refíciam vos.

misericorsetmiseratordominus.en: Merciful and gracious is the Lord.

escamdedittimentibusse.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him.

tollitehostiasetintroiteinatriadominiado.en: Bring up * sacrifices, and come into the courts of the Lord, adoring him in his holy temple.
tollitehostiasetintroiteinatriadominiado.la: Tóllite * hóstias, et introíte in átria Dómini, adorántes ipsum in templo sancto ejus. Ps. 95

miseratoretmisericorsdominusrepletinboni.en: Gracious * and merciful is the Lord: he filleth thy desire with good things.
miseratoretmisericorsdominusrepletinboni.la: Miserátor * et miséricors Dóminus replet in bonis desidérium tuum. Ps. 102

educaspanemdeterretvinumletificetcorhomi.en: That thou mayst bring bread * out of the earth, and that wine may cheer the heart of man.
educaspanemdeterretvinumletificetcorhomi.la: Edúcas panem * de terra, et vinum lætíficet cor hóminis. Ps. 103

omniaateexpectantdomine.en: All things look to thee, O Lord.

utdesillisescamintempore.en: That thou mayest give them food in season.
utdesillisescamintempore.la: Ut des illis escam in témpore.

sapientiaedificavitsibidomummiscuitvinum.en: Wisdom hath builded her house, * she hath mingled her wine, she hath also furnished her table, alleluia.
sapientiaedificavitsibidomummiscuitvinum.la: Sapiéntia * ædificávit sibi domum, míscuit vinum, et pósuit mensam, allelúia. Ps. 272, 214, 273

eduxitvosdominusinmanufortideterraegypti.en: The Lord brought you out with a strong hand from the land of Egypt:
eduxitvosdominusinmanufortideterraegypti.la: Edúxit vos Dóminus in manu forti de terra Ægypti:

quieduxitdepetrarivosetcibavitvosmannain.en: Who brought forth streams out of the rock, and fed you with manna in the wilderness.
quieduxitdepetrarivosetcibavitvosmannain.la: Qui edúxit de petra rivos, et cibávit vos manna in solitúdine.

nonmoysesdeditvobispanemdecelosedpaterme.en: Moses gave you not that Bread from heaven, but My Father giveth you the true Bread from heaven.
nonmoysesdeditvobispanemdecelosedpaterme.la: Non Móyses dedit vobis panem de cælo, sed Pater meus dat vobis panem de cælo verum:

melchisedechrexsalemsacerdosdeialtissimi.en: Melchisedech, King of Salem, Priest of the Most High God, bringing forth bread and wine, prefigured of the Body of Christ
melchisedechrexsalemsacerdosdeialtissimi.la: Melchísedech Rex Salem, Sacérdos Dei Altíssimi, próferens panem et vinum, præfigurávit Córporis Christi

sanctumsacrificiumimmaculatamhostiam.en: The holy sacrifice, the spotless victim.

introivitiesuspronobissecundumordinemmel.en: Jesus entered in for us according to the order of Melchisedech, by offering himself once:
introivitiesuspronobissecundumordinemmel.la: Introívit Jesus pro nobis secúndum órdinem Melchísedech, semel offeréndo seípsum:

cumquesurrexissetetaccepissetcibumconfor.en: And when he had arisen and taken food, he was strengthened in the Holy Ghost:
cumquesurrexissetetaccepissetcibumconfor.la: Cumque surrexísset et accepísset cibum, confortátus est in Spíritu sancto:

quimanducatmeamcarnemetbibitmeumsanguine.en: He that eateth my Flesh and drinketh my Blood abideth in me, and I in him:
quimanducatmeamcarnemetbibitmeumsanguine.la: Qui mandúcat meam Carnem et bibit meum Sánguinem, in me manet, et ego in illo:

carenimmeavereestcibusetsanguismeusveree.en: For my Flesh is meat indeed, and my Blood is drink indeed.
carenimmeavereestcibusetsanguismeusveree.la: Caro enim mea vere est cibus, et Sanguis meus vere est potus.

comediteamicibibiteetinebriaminicharissi.en: Eat, O friends, and drink, and be inebriated, my dearly beloved:
comediteamicibibiteetinebriaminicharissi.la: Comédite amíci, bíbite, et inebriámini, charíssimi:

inmegratiaomnisvieetveritatisinmeomnissp.en: In me is all grace of the way and of the truth, in me is all hope of life and of virtue.
inmegratiaomnisvieetveritatisinmeomnissp.la: In me grátia omnis viæ et veritátis, in me omnis spes vitæ et virtútis.

cenantibusillisaccepitiesuspanemetbenedi.en: As they were at supper, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and broke, and gave to his disciples, saying: Take ye and eat:
cenantibusillisaccepitiesuspanemetbenedi.la: Cœnántibus illis, accépit Jesus panem, et benedíxit, ac fregit, dedítque discípulis suis, dicens: Accípite et comédite:

videntesfiliiisrelmannaindesertoadmirant.en: The children of Israel, seeing the manna in the desert, said in wonder: What is this?
videntesfiliiisrelmannaindesertoadmirant.la: Vidéntes fílii Israël manna in desérto, admirántes dicébant: Quid est hoc?

veniteetcomeditepanemmeumetbibitevinumqu.en: Come, eat my bread, and drink the wine which I have mingled for you.
veniteetcomeditepanemmeumetbibitevinumqu.la: Veníte et comédite panem meum, et bíbite vinum quod míscui vobis.

angelorumescanutrispopulumtuumdomineetpa.en: With the food of Angels thou feedest thy people, O Lord, and givest us bread from heaven, having in it all that is delicious:
angelorumescanutrispopulumtuumdomineetpa.la: Angelórum esca nutris pópulum tuum, Dómine, et panem de cœlo dans nobis omne delectaméntum in se habéntem:

substantiametdulcedinemtuamquamhabesinfi.en: Shewing forth thy sustenance and thy sweetness which thou hast toward thy children:
substantiametdulcedinemtuamquamhabesinfi.la: Substántiam, et dulcédinem tuam quam habes in fílios ostendéndo:

dominequidasvitammundosemperdanobispanem.en: Lord, who givest life to the world, give us always the true bread:
dominequidasvitammundosemperdanobispanem.la: Dómine, qui das vitam mundo, semper da nobis panem verum:

viditreginasabasapientiamsalomonisdomumq.en: The Queen of Saba saw the wisdom of Solomon, and the house which he had built, and the meat of his table, and their apparel:
viditreginasabasapientiamsalomonisdomumq.la: Vidit Regína Saba sapiéntiam Salomónis, domum quam ædificáverat, cibos mensæ ejus, et vestiménta eórum:

etadmiransdixitbeatiservituiquiaudiuntsa.en: And marvelling, she said: Blessed are thy servants, who hear thy wisdom.
etadmiransdixitbeatiservituiquiaudiuntsa.la: Et admírans, dixit: Beáti servi tui, qui áudiunt sapiéntiam tuam.

reginaaustrivenitafinibusterreaudiresapi.en: The Queen of the South came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon.
reginaaustrivenitafinibusterreaudiresapi.la: Regína Austri venit a fínibus terræ audíre sapiéntiam Salomónis.

gaudeamusetexultemusetdemusgloriamdeoqui.en: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give glory to God; for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath prepared herself.
gaudeamusetexultemusetdemusgloriamdeoqui.la: Gaudeámus et exultémus, et demus glóriam Deo, quia venérunt núptiæ Agni, et uxor ejus præparávit se.

beatiquicenamnuptiarumeiusvocatisunt.en: Blessed are they that are called to the marriage supper of the Lamb.
beatiquicenamnuptiarumeiusvocatisunt.la: Beáti qui cœnam nuptiárum ejus vocáti sunt.

assuerusproconiunctioneetnuptiishesterpe.en: Assuerus, for his union and marriage with Esther, prepared a very magnificent feast.
assuerusproconiunctioneetnuptiishesterpe.la: Assuérus pro conjunctióne, et núptiis Hester permagníficum convívium præparávit.

laudetdevotedominumpresenschorusquiinsue.en: Let the choir here present * devoutly praise the Lord, who, for the everlasting memory of his passion, giveth himself as food to the people that draw nigh unto him.
laudetdevotedominumpresenschorusquiinsue.la: Laudet devóte * Dóminum præsens chorus, qui in suæ passiónis perénnem memóriam, seípsum præbet in cibum pópulo appropinquánti sibi.

inmundiprimordiishomoprimusmortisescamsu.en: In the beginning * of the world the first man gave his posterity the food of death to drink, but the second, who came from heaven, giveth himself to the clean of heart as the food of life.
inmundiprimordiishomoprimusmortisescamsu.la: In mundi * primórdiis homo primus mortis escam suis pósteris propinávit, sed secúndus, qui de cœlo venit, mundis corde se tríbuit escam vitæ.

gustatecunctifidelesquamdulcisestdominus.en: Taste, * all ye faithful, how sweet is the Lord, who giveth us on the Altar as saving food his Body that was crucified at the third hour for the salvation of the world: let us all adore him, who cometh to save us.
gustatecunctifidelesquamdulcisestdominus.la: Gustáte * cuncti fideles, quam dulcis est Dóminus, nobis Corpus suum hora tértia crucifíxum pro mundi salúte in salvíficum cibum tríbuens in Altári: omnes ipsum adorémus, qui venit salváre nos.

oluxmeridianailluminansomniairradiacorda.en: O light * of noonday, that enlightenest all things, shine upon our hearts, that they may know the mysteries of so great a Sacrament.
oluxmeridianailluminansomniairradiacorda.la: O lux * meridiána, illúminans ómnia, irrádia corda nostra ad tanti Sacraménti mystéria cognoscénda.

opastorbonequirelictisnonagintanovemovib.en: O good shepherd, * who, leaving the ninety-nine sheep in the desert, didst bring back the lost sheep to the flock, feed us with the nourishment of thy sacred Body.
opastorbonequirelictisnonagintanovemovib.la: O pastor bone, * qui relíctis nonagínta novem óvibus in desérto, ad gregem ovem pérditam reportásti, pasce nos tui sacri Córporis aliménto.

memoriamfecitmirabiliumsuorummiseratordo.en: He hath made a remembrance of his wonderful works, * being a merciful Lord.
memoriamfecitmirabiliumsuorummiseratordo.la: Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, * Miserátor Dóminus.

cibavitillosexadipefrumenti.en: He fed them with the fat of wheat.

benedictussitcreatoretredemptorfideliumq.en: Blessed be * the Creator and Redeemer of the faithful, who, being mindful of his holy testament, whereby he had promised that he would give himself to us, hath visited us, the Orient from on high: and being about to die on the cross for us, left us a pledge of his boundless love, giving us the most precious Sacrament of his Body and Blood.
benedictussitcreatoretredemptorfideliumq.la: Benedíctus sit * Creátor, et Redémptor fidélium, qui memor testaménti sui sancti, quo promíserat datúrum se nobis, visitávit nos óriens ex alto: et in cruce moritúrus pro nobis, relíquit pignus amóris imménsi, donans nobis sui Córporis et Sánguinis pretiosíssimum Sacraméntum.

osacramentumpietatisosignumunitatisovinc.en: O Sacrament * of godliness, O sign of unity, O bond of charity, who refreshest us on the way under another's appearance; after the course of this present life refresh us in our fatherland, with face now revealed, without appearance between, alleluia.
